description: S-L1 argala lane (SS N-61 AR-1..AR-6; PR #2851; migration 1219 ownership + count_sql seeds are in the integration). ga_structural (a) emits the NEW category argala_graha_natal: graha-level argala rows (BPHS pairing, both-node reversal) on D1 only, one row per (target graha, source graha) at an argala offset, verification tier single; (b) rewrites argala_natal_matrix: fact_value_num 1.0 -> NULL and fact_value_text NULL -> 'no_occupant' on the argala-offset cells (2, 4, 5, 11) whose source sign holds no graha (a 'value' change per such cell), plus source_calculation, formula_provenance_text and citation_human text (not detector fields); (c) virodha_argala_natal_matrix changes source_calculation and formula_provenance_text only. net_argala_per_varga and contradiction_pair do not change from this lane. The ga_sade_sati argala_during_period_jsonb subset loses the activations from empty source signs (fact_value_jsonb is not a detector field). The full per-ayanamsha declaration (families, distributions, columns changed, integrity / ownership / digest effects) is kept verbatim in evidence/argala_HOOK_DECLARATION_old_shape.json (the lane's original hook, written before the hook schema existed; it uses categories / category_regex and has no may_change, which the detector rejects as HOOK_ERROR). Counts are for the canonical chart and are the lane's own evidence (offline model identical to the writer on all five ayanamshas), pre-ephemeris; the ephemeris flip report (flips_native.json) shows NO class flip on the canonical chart, so occupancy, and therefore these counts, do not move with it. Other charts: argala_other_charts.json.
